_comment_about_this_file: Claude Code plugin MARKETPLACE catalog for kanbanr (roadmap FEAT-023).
It lists exactly one plugin — `kanbanr` — whose source is this same repo.
Usage for end users:
claude plugin marketplace add <github-owner>/kanbanr
claude plugin install kanbanr@kanbanr
(or the in-app /plugin marketplace add + /plugin install equivalents).
VERIFY-AGAINST-DOCS (per code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces,
current as of 2026-06):
- name (required): marketplace id (kebab-case). Users reference it as
`plugin@<this-name>`. Must NOT collide with reserved Anthropic names.
- owner (required): { name, email? }.
- plugins (required): array; each entry needs `name` + `source`.
- source `"./"`: a relative path (must start with `./`) resolved from the
marketplace ROOT (the dir containing this .claude-plugin/). Here the
plugin IS the repo root, so its source is `"./"` and its manifest is the
sibling .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Relative-path sources only work when
the marketplace is added via git (GitHub/GitLab/git URL), which is the
intended distribution path.
`_comment*` keys are ignored by Claude Code (strict JSON, unknown keys
dropped) and may be stripped.
